text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaagh!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, what momentum...!
Is she shifting into an even higher gear—?)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (...So strong.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(It's completely different from the 'Satsuki Sho.'
Far more so than back then—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: More, I need even more...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Just how strong do you want to become?
Do you still intend to keep growing?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Isn't that kind of strength just too arrogant?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...If that's how it is.
Then I won't—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I want to get stronger... I don't want to end things here.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“—I want wings to surpass you, my idol, someday,
and take flight toward the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
*pant*... *gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Aah, geez!!
I lostーーーー!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...!
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
In the end, until I broke these legs of mine,
I was never able to give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...I wanted to become someone who could
chase after them with everything I have one day."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I stopped myself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Brian-chan's run was incredible, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"She doesn't let her innate talent go to her head—she just earnestly pursues pure speed.
She's completely flawless, to the point it feels unfair."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Still, I won't lose either!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure that in the remaining Kikuka Sho,
Brian-chan will show us an incredibly
powerful run."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I'll keep holding onto the desire to beat that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep wishing that someday,
I'll be running out ahead of her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Though, Brian-chan might not even
recognize me as a rival yet."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...I want to be like her, too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "For that reason, I'd love for Brian-chan to become even stronger at the Kikuka Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'd rather they be completely unbeatable!
Because that way—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Before someone else takes them down,
I'll have my chance to defeat them!

Sakura Laurel looks ahead.
Straight toward the ideal she yearns for.
—She hesitates no longer.
